ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Kolibi to access your camera to take photos of your meals, scan barcodes, and set a profile picture.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow Kolibi to access your photos to set a profile picture.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Kolibi saves your stickers to your photo library.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Kolibi reads active energy, heart rate, steps, walking/running distance, waist circumference, body fat percentage, lean body mass and workouts from Apple Health so that your daily and movement goals can take your activity into account.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Kolibi writes your logged waist circumference to Apple Health so that it is visible there together with your other health data.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Allow Kolibi to access your Face ID biometric data.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Kolibi to access your microphone.
